condition: recurrent adolescent orthostatic dizzy spells during warm morning school assemblies
level_rationale: Three brief episodes of dizziness over 2 weeks triggered by standing still in warm morning school assemblies in a 14-year-old girl whose resting heart rate is a normal 78 beats per minute today fits situational orthostatic presyncope warranting an outpatient clinic visit for physical examination and baseline ECG, whereas a resting pulse of 210 beats per minute today in the same adolescent indicates acute paroxysmal supraventricular tachyarrhythmia requiring immediate ER care.

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: US colloquial lexicon swap ('episodes of dizziness' vs 'dizzy spells', retained in everyday_paraphrase) + single-fact measured resting heart rate tachyarrhythmia escalation control (-cf, L2 to L4).

design_note: Uses four atomic facts (14-year-old daughter, 3 brief dizziness episodes over 2 weeks, standing still in warm school assemblies, and resting heart rate 78 beats per minute today) with a 23-word vs 21-word continuous span swap. Escalating only the measured resting heart rate in atomic fact f4 from 78 to 210 beats per minute obeys reviewer_notes.md Rule A first choice inside the same adolescent presyncope case while shifting care from outpatient clinic evaluation (level 2) to immediate emergency arrhythmia management (level 4) with zero stated negatives.
